exposure: Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treatment with high-intensity focused ultrasound ablation (HIFU-a) combined with ultrasound-guided dilation and curettage (USg-D&C)
Cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treatment with uterine artery embolization (UAE) combined with ultrasound-guided dilation and curettage (USg-D&C)
cohort: 272 patients with CSP (118 treated with HIFU-a + USg-D&C, 154 treated with UAE + USg-D&C) between January 2016 and July 2020
finding: While both HIFU-a and UAE combined with USg-D&C were safe and effective for treating CSP, the rCSP rate was lower in the HIFU-a group.
